name: Mavis
says: Good heavens, love! Have you finally stopped dreaming and painted the gatepost that mustard-yellow colour while I try to sip my tea in peace? It's absolutely magnificent with all those bright splodges on your own nose!
wants: A proper lace doily right under the 'Bottle Green' paint plate so Pea doesn't run a red spot across his face when he jumps over it!
